$schema_note: Maps each expert_source_id (bots/theta/quant/expert_priors/data/expert_sources.json) to the THETA research archetype(s) (bots/theta/quant/research/data/strategy_archetypes.json) their evidence is relevant to. An expert may map to more than one archetype -- their observed/reconstructed behavior is not forced into a single clean category. Contradictions between experts mapped to the same archetype are NOT resolved here by averaging; they surface as separate, explicitly competing hypotheses in bots/theta/quant/research/data/hypotheses.json instead (see e.g. H-R-01 vs H-R-02).

mappings.note: Patience and acceptable-ownership evidence supports THETA-Q; the CSP->stock->CC full-cycle framing spans THETA-A (assignment/recovery) and THETA-C (the CC leg as the cycle's terminal monetization step).

Active CSP/CC/Wheel management spans close/roll (THETA-R), CC management (THETA-C), and assignment behavior (THETA-A) -- not confined to one.
Rolling/adjustment evolution is core THETA-R evidence; 'assignment lifecycle' framing also touches THETA-A.

Cross-cutting: 'portfolio/structure routing across CSP/CC/spreads/IC' is a routing-level hypothesis that does not fit one archetype cleanly -- recorded against both the management (THETA-R) and defined-risk-structure (THETA-D) archetypes rather than forced into a single label.
Direct match: explicitly a defined-risk/small-account archetype, and TRD itself says not to merge it with main-account policy.
BUY_CLOSE / active inventory management is a management-timing (close/roll-adjacent) behavior.
Conservative income process reads as an entry/ownership-quality posture, the weakest-evidence fit of the six archetypes given the explicit 'evidence-strength limits' caveat.
Same cross-cutting structure-routing theme as Ivan Orehovec -- recorded against both, explicitly 'research prior only until evidence improves.'

This is the cross-cutting failure-DNA constraint recorded in strategy_archetypes.json's cross_cutting_failure_dna block, not a positive strategy prior for any single archetype -- it applies to all of them equally, which is why it is not narrowed to THETA-A alone despite assignment/recovery being where the risk is sharpest.

Value/quality-ownership framing (THETA-Q) combined with drawdown caution most relevant to assignment/recovery reporting discipline (THETA-A); also listed in the cross-cutting failure-DNA block as a failure/mechanism study, not a strategy to copy.
